title: Palantir Strengthens Army Partnership, Adds AI And Data Enhancements In $618.9 Million Contract
description: Palantir extended its partnership with the U.S. Army for the Army Vantage capability, valued at $400.7 million over four years with a $618.9 million ceiling. The agreement aims to enhance data and AI integration across the Army, supporting over 100,000 users and expanding the platform's mission scope.
